gaps.title: Text-only completion scope
gaps.finding: Original requirement 12.1, D10 and task 5.6 permit completing a text-focused certificate while broadly denying media.

gaps.title: Omitted native backend owners
gaps.finding: The original four-family packets omit the distinct Bedrock and Alibaba contributions.

gaps.title: Generic connector certification is insufficient
gaps.finding: A common connector transport proof does not exercise each of 34 module-native encoders, usage mappings or economic limits.

gaps.title: Input and output canonical media loss
gaps.finding: Image/file references alone lack the joint output plan and candidate/media chunk identity needed for full mixed semantics.

gaps.title: Native economic options can be silently ignored
gaps.finding: The Gemini decoder omits fileData and much native generation configuration in the inspected path.

gaps.title: Individual capabilities do not prove a mixture
gaps.finding: An exact native output combination cannot be reconstructed from independent modality booleans.

gaps.title: Reference size/count estimates are not hard bounds
gaps.finding: Media resource processing, mutable references and estimated counts need explicit bounded input proofs.

gaps.title: Mixed native rates need disjoint support
gaps.finding: Modality/cache/reasoning/prediction marginals, inclusive totals and multiple candidates require exact scopes, not additive field sums.

gaps.title: Media-only and failed output can lose economics
gaps.finding: The proof must separate actual provider work from text visibility, chunks, assets and output collection.

gaps.title: Transport and reusable lifecycle axes are not closed
gaps.finding: Independent upstream mode, WebSocket logical operations, compaction and async resource identity require separate obligations.

gaps.title: Representative pair tests are not exhaustive
gaps.finding: Original family-plus-sentinel gate cannot establish every pair and mixed signature; changing the denominator could hide failures.

gaps.title: Finite fixtures need compositional tests and truthful claims
gaps.finding: Signature enumeration alone cannot prove arbitrary order/count/nesting, every future schema, or an unbounded external operation.
